page.overview:
What is Mane Mane no Mi?

The Mane Mane no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn themselves into a physical double of anyone they touch, making the user an . It was eaten by former Baroque Works agent Bentham, also known by the alias Mr. 2 Bon Kurei.

It had previously been eaten by Kurozumi Higurashi before she was killed by Kaidou.

The Mane Mane no Mi resembles a pair of fruits with connected stems. Each fruit is orange with pink stripes, with various swirls present on the orange backdrop.

The fruit allows the user to impersonate someone they touch with their right hand, adopting their face, physique, and voice. The fruit keeps a perfect recollection of every person whose form they have ever copied, so the user will not forget any person's appearance whom they imitate. There's no time limit for the transformation, and the user can revert back to their own body by touching their face with their left hand, even if unintentionally.
